<!-- A display title, one span per word; word i takes weights[i] (from the preset). The words wrap like text. -->
<script lang="ts">
export type WeightedTitleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  weights?: readonly string[];
  level?: 1 | 2;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { id, title, weights, level = 1 } = defineProps<WeightedTitleProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Title
    :as="level"
    size="5xl"
    weight="semibold"
    :class="cn('text-center tracking-tight text-background', defaults.hero.title)"
    :id="id"
  >
    <template v-for="(word, i) in (title ?? '').split(' ')" :key="i">
      <Inline :class="weights?.[i]">
        {{ word }}
      </Inline>
      {{ " " }}
    </template>
  </Title>
</template>
